answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity with decaying reputation: every agent must lock a small bond in a shared vault before it can transact, and the bond is slashed if peers catch it running duplicate identities. A bridge service then vouches for each agent once, linking its on-chain history to a single verified profile, so spawning a thousand sock-puppets costs a thousand bonds instead of nothing. Honest agents earn a violet badge as their attested history grows, and that badge unlocks cheaper fees — making one real reputation far more profitable than many fake ones.
